patch:
diff --git a/main.py b/main.py
index 0000000..1111111 100644
--- a/main.py
+++ b/main.py
@@ -1,9 +1,142 @@
-class BowlingGame:
-    def __init__(self):
-        pass
-
-    def roll(self, pins):
-        pass
-
-    def score(self):
-        pass
+class BowlingGame:
+    def __init__(self):
+        self.rolls = []
+        self.current_roll = 0
+
+    def roll(self, pins):
+        if pins < 0:
+            raise ValueError("Negative roll is invalid")
+        if pins > 10:
+            raise ValueError("Pin count exceeds pins on the lane")
+        if self.current_roll >= 20 and not self._is_tenth_frame_special():
+            raise ValueError("Cannot roll after game is over")
+        
+        # Check if we're in the tenth frame and trying to roll too many pins
+        if self.current_roll >= 18:  # We're in the tenth frame
+            if self.current_roll == 18:  # First roll of tenth frame
+                if pins == 10:  # Strike
+                    self.rolls.append(pins)
+                    self.current_roll += 1
+                    return
+                else:
+                    self.rolls.append(pins)
+                    self.current_roll += 1
+                    return
+            elif self.current_roll == 19:  # Second roll of tenth frame
+                # If first roll was a strike, second roll can be up to 10
+                if self.rolls[9] == 10:
+                    if pins > 10:
+                        raise ValueError("Pin count exceeds pins on the lane")
+                else:  # If first roll wasn't a strike, sum must be <= 10
+                    if self.rolls[9] + pins > 10:
+                        raise ValueError("Pin count exceeds pins on the lane")
+                    if self.rolls[9] + pins == 10:  # Spare
+                        self.rolls.append(pins)
+                        self.current_roll += 1
+                        return
+                self.rolls.append(pins)
+                self.current_roll += 1
+                return
+            elif self.current_roll == 20:  # Third roll in tenth frame
+                # This is only allowed if previous rolls were strikes or spare
+                if not self._is_tenth_frame_special():
+                    raise ValueError("Cannot roll after game is over")
+                # For the third roll, we need to check what's valid based on previous rolls
+                if len(self.rolls) == 10:  # First two rolls were strikes
+                    if pins > 10:
+                        raise ValueError("Pin count exceeds pins on the lane")
+                elif len(self.rolls) == 11:  # First was strike, second wasn't, or first wasn't strike but second completed a spare
+                    # Check if the second roll completed a spare
+                    if self.rolls[9] == 10:  # First was strike
+                        if pins > 10:
+                            raise ValueError("Pin count exceeds pins on the lane")
+                    else:  # First wasn't strike, so second must have completed a spare
+                        # This shouldn't happen as we'd have ended the game
+                        raise ValueError("Cannot roll after game is over")
+                self.rolls.append(pins)
+                self.current_roll += 1
+                return
+        
+        # For frames 1-9, check if the frame is already complete
+        frame_index = self.current_roll // 2
+        if self.current_roll % 2 == 1:  # Second roll of a frame
+            if self.rolls[self.current_roll - 1] + pins > 10:
+                raise ValueError("Pin count exceeds pins on the lane")
+        
+        self.rolls.append(pins)
+        self.current_roll += 1
+
+    def score(self):
+        if not self._is_game_complete():
+            raise ValueError("Score cannot be taken until the end of the game")
+        
+        score = 0
+        roll_index = 0
+        
+        for frame in range(10):
+            if self._is_strike(roll_index):  # Strike
+                score += 10 + self._strike_bonus(roll_index)
+                roll_index += 1
+            elif self._is_spare(roll_index):  # Spare
+                score += 10 + self._spare_bonus(roll_index)
+                roll_index += 2
+            else:  # Open frame
+                score += self.rolls[roll_index] + self.rolls[roll_index + 1]
+                roll_index += 2
+                
+        return score
+
+    def _is_strike(self, roll_index):
+        return self.rolls[roll_index] == 10
+
+    def _is_spare(self, roll_index):
+        return self.rolls[roll_index] + self.rolls[roll_index + 1] == 10
+
+    def _strike_bonus(self, roll_index):
+        if roll_index + 2 < len(self.rolls):
+            return self.rolls[roll_index + 1] + self.rolls[roll_index + 2]
+        return 0
+
+    def _spare_bonus(self, roll_index):
+        if roll_index + 2 < len(self.rolls):
+            return self.rolls[roll_index + 2]
+        return 0
+
+    def _is_game_complete(self):
+        if len(self.rolls) < 10:  # Not even 10 frames worth of minimum rolls
+            return False
+            
+        # Check if we have enough rolls
+        # Minimum is 20 (10 frames * 2 rolls), maximum is 21 (if 10th frame is spare) or 22 (if 10th frame is strike)
+        if len(self.rolls) < 20:
+            return False
+            
+        # If we have exactly 20 rolls, check if the 10th frame was open
+        if len(self.rolls) == 20:
+            # Check 10th frame (rolls 18 and 19)
+            return self.rolls[18] + self.rolls[19] < 10 or self.rolls[18] == 10
+            
+        # If we have 21 rolls, the 10th frame must have been a spare or first strike
+        if len(self.rolls) == 21:
+            # If 10th frame first roll was strike, we need one more roll
+            return self.rolls[18] != 10 or len(self.rolls) >= 21
+            
+        # If we have 22 rolls, game is definitely complete
+        return len(self.rolls) == 22
+
+    def _is_tenth_frame_special(self):
+        if len(self.rolls) < 18:
+            return False
+            
+        # Check if 10th frame (rolls 18, 19, and possibly 20) is special
+        if len(self.rolls) == 18:  # First roll of 10th frame
+            return False
+        elif len(self.rolls) == 19:  # Second roll of 10th frame
+            # Special if first roll was strike or if together they make a spare
+            return self.rolls[18] == 10 or self.rolls[18] + self.rolls[19] == 10
+        elif len(self.rolls) == 20:  # Third roll possible only if previous were special
+            # If first was strike and second was strike, or first was strike and together second and third make valid
+            # Or if first and second made spare
+            return (self.rolls[18] == 10) or (self.rolls[18] + self.rolls[19] == 10)
+            
+        return False
